title: Llama reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Llama body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#F2D9B0'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#D9B57F'/>
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#F2D9B0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='82' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#D9B57F'/>
  <rect x='66' y='80' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#F2D9B0'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='34' y='28' width='13' height='38' rx='6' fill='#F2D9B0'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#F2D9B0'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='11' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#F2D9B0' transform='rotate(-15 30 11)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='10' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#F2D9B0' transform='rotate(10 45 10)'/>

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='10' rx='2' ry='4.5' fill='#E8B98C' transform='rotate(10 45 10)'/>

  <ellipse cx='31' cy='26' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#E8B98C'/>

  <circle cx='35' cy='19' r='2' fill='#3B2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='19' r='2' fill='#3B2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='35.7' cy='18.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6E8'/>
  <circle cx='43.7' cy='18.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6E8'/>
  <!-- Book held in front -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 60 66)'>
    <rect x='48' y='58' width='30' height='22' rx='2' fill='#D64545'/>
    <rect x='49' y='59' width='13' height='20' fill='#FFF6E8'/>
    <rect x='63' y='59' width='13' height='20' fill='#FFF6E8'/>
    <rect x='62' y='59' width='2' height='20' fill='#B53333'/>
    <line x1='52' y1='64' x2='59' y2='64' stroke='#C8B8A8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='52' y1='68' x2='59' y2='68' stroke='#C8B8A8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='52' y1='72' x2='59' y2='72' stroke='#C8B8A8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='66' y1='64' x2='73' y2='64' stroke='#C8B8A8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='66' y1='68' x2='73' y2='68' stroke='#C8B8A8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='66' y1='72' x2='73' y2='72' stroke='#C8B8A8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Hooves on book -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='79' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#D9B57F'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='79' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#D9B57F'/>
</svg>
